description: All tickers consumed by us_cpi_fixings.py. Single source of truth — the Python module reads tickers directly from this file.

historical_series.label: CPI (NSA)
historical_series.description: US CPI All Urban Consumers, Not Seasonally Adjusted — settlement index for USD CPI inflation swaps

historical_series.label: CPI (SA)
historical_series.description: US CPI All Urban Consumers, Seasonally Adjusted. In simulation mode, derived from NSA via STL decomposition.
historical_series.simulation_note: Computed from NSA via STL in simulation; fetched directly from Bloomberg in live mode.

historical_series.label: Core CPI
historical_series.description: US CPI All Items Less Food and Energy (core CPI), NSA

historical_series.label: Core Goods
historical_series.haver_note: CPI core goods index level not confirmed in Haver. Check CPIXFEG@USECON.
historical_series.description: US CPI commodities less food and energy commodities (core goods)

historical_series.label: Core Services
historical_series.haver_note: CPI core services index level not confirmed in Haver. Check CPIXFES@USECON.
historical_series.description: US CPI services less energy services (core services)

f_series.description: USD CPI F-series calendar-month fixings (synthetic convention — Bloomberg does not publish monthly CPI fixings in this format). In live mode, derive from USSWIT{n} Curncy standard-tenor CPI swaps interpolated to calendar months.

t_series.description: USD CPI T-series calendar-month fixings (synthetic convention). See F-series note.

live_bloomberg_alternative.description: USD CPI NSA zero-coupon inflation swaps — standard tenors in years. Requires interpolation to convert to calendar-month YoY rates for level reconstruction.
